programme.title: Mr & Mrs Incredible
programme.desc: Bored with their mundane country lifestyle, a retired superhero couple sets out to make a comeback at the upcoming Martial World Assembly.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Tiger Wong is ambushed after taking the Lousha Plaque, but is saved by his brother and also befriends Turbo Shek. To avenge the death of Dragon Gate masters, the trio vow to defeat Lousha Clan leader.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Two sworn brothers become enemies after the girl they love marries one of them. The rivalry is only resolved when the property owner of their shops wants to terminate their tenancies 40 years later.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: When a school bus driver is injured after risking his life to save a boy during an accident, the boy's father invites him to live with them. However, disturbing facts soon begin to emerge.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: A private detective uncovers his wife's betrayal during a case. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case, only to find the subject murdered, and revealing a string of serial killings.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner & his brother are pulled into a gang war.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must prove herself in the afterlife by delivering spectacular scares. A washed-up ghost diva and her agent help her battle to earn her haunting licence, or else she will vanish.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a case where the body was undiscovered for 8 years. During the investigation, the prosecutor finds all inconsistencies & suspicions fall on Choi.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: After being discovered flirting with his boss' daughter, Sing gets blown up, but later gets relived as his professor transforms him to be a cyborg of household products.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress.

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three tales merges in this satire set against Hong Kong's housing crisis, where soaring property prices have driven people to desperate measures - including sharing a space with the dead!

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Echoes of the Thunder
programme.desc: Nam and Fire are top racing drivers. Nam is depressed after causing a young racing driver's injury. Fire decides to compete in an illegal street car race to stand up for Nam. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Marriage with a Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and Sean, who have been together for seven years, betray each other three days before their wedding. Faced with 'perfect' partners, they abandon their responsibilities and part ways.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports team—all for a HK$500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Linghu Chong wishes to leave the martial world but gets drawn into a violent feud. He falls for Dongfang Bubai, but a tragic misunderstanding leads to a fatal showdown.

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Jaycee Chan plays a 20-something slacker who discovers a magical website that may help reunite him and his girlfriend but at what cost?

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a visually impaired factory worker living in an island. After a hurricane cut them off from the outside world, a monster suddenly appears, turning whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Chan plays Eddie Yang, a Hong Kong cop who is working with Interpol officer Arthur Watson in order to protect a gifted young child.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis, his marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him.

programme.title: Mad Fate

programme.title: Discover New Taiwan Step by Step
programme.desc: The creative production team goes around Taiwan in search of inspiring stories in the country. Get to know more unique individuals and discover the true spirit of Taiwan.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: Director Ho Meng-hua presents an all-star cast in this searing martial arts extravaganza that will bewitch you with its swift swordplay.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies' sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh teams up with the Five Venoms in this martial arts saga that captures the fab five at their swashbuckling best.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two rebel Shaolin warriors embark on a deadly secret mission aimed at bringing down the Ching Dynasty. Starring Lo Meng, Chin Siu Ho.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: After an inn-keeper's daughter witnesses a perverted rape, her true love must rescue her from the greater danger that threatens.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master (Lau Kar Leung) is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: To save his son from being killed, the head of the Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends his son to be hidden by a master fighter. Will the boy prove a hero?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer/ director Yueh Feng's most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: A Shaw kung fu classic from 1984, this film depicts the trials of a young hero who sets out to avenge his parents' death.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: In this 'Flying Guillotine' follow-up, a fearless woman (Chen Ping) takes on a flying guillotine gang even while she's pregnant!

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: This entertaining 'Robin Hood' epic features a hero who steals from the thieves and gives to the poor which sets the thieves on the warpath.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: In true Huangmei opera style, lovely Li Hsiang-chun stars as a used and abused beauty in director Kao Li's restrained, as well as sadistic tearjerker.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: Angel With the Iron Fists
programme.desc: After her father is killed by gangsters, a young woman seeks revenge plus bids to ensure that justice is served. Starring Lily Ho.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: After a guilty Alex confesses his affair to Tung, his injured wife, she somehow ends up living with Alex's mother and his mistress under the same roof!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: At first, a gang just wants the village locksmith to open a stolen safe, but it soon escalates into wholesale torment when they are met with resistance.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: The court intrigues, politicking, bickering and backstabbing continues in this sequel to The Empress Dowager. Starring Lisa Lu.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: A woman sets up a troubled love triangle involving 2 swordsmen (Ti Lung and Lau Wing) and an enchanting lady (Ching Li).

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this 'Martial Arts World' saga of a masked master of the 'Black Sand Hand Technique,' starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: After a bride-to-be is discovered to be possessed, justice must be done and an exorcism performed before anyone can rest in peace.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The first make HK$1 million at the local box office, Chang Cheh's Wuxia film sparked a new age in martial arts films with its male anti-heroes and violence.

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Pauline Wong plays a pregnant student who marries a sympathetic, yet equally heartbroken, passer-by in Jamie Luk's directing debut.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Share the exploits of two con men vying for a horde of hidden gold. In addition to the mix is a Shaolin monk and his dangerous mute sister!

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: In this comedy, hellish emotions are unleashed when a demon arranges to have his true love killed in order to possess her. Starring Lo Meng.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Serio-comic clashes of cultures ensue when a Mainland Chinese family try to make a go of it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Martial arts star Jimmy Wang Yu plays Kwei Wu, who unites with his wife Kan to battle kidnappers at the Red Lotus Temple.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt official's obsessive bid to find a hidden treasure leads him to jail and torture his daughter's lover, and bury her alive!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Wong Yue and Gordon Liu star in this entertaining 'hopping vampire' action comedy.

programme.title: Perils of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: This well-named cliffhanger is fraught with adventure involving a mystery swordsman, a sensual swordswoman, an imperial assassin, a Ghost Mansion and more!

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Michelle Mei Suet plays Szu-szu, a spoiled girl who leaves her beau Yang Fan, to go off in search of a swordsman whom she idolizes. Whom will she end up with?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The retired one-armed swordsman made his reappearance to fight against the brutal robbers and protect the peace of the martial art world.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses' parents enter into the picture.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: As a young clan member rises to helm the Dragon gang after his foster father's death, an incriminating letter changes everything. Can he fight the tide?

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: In this saga of two warring clans, Tsao Feng from the Flag of Iron betrays Lo, his master and teams up with the enemy. Unexpectedly, Lo returns for revenge.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A motorcycle workshop owner feels compelled to damn the physical and legal consequences and go on racing.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: When a top boxer (Lau Kar Leung) refuses to obey an imperial eunuch, other martial arts experts are sent to hunt him down and kill him.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Chiang Li Ping plays a scorned wife, while Elaine Chin Yen Ling is the mistress who teaches the hypocritical husband that what goes around, comes around.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: In John Lo Mar's masterpiece, an old medicine seller and his three apprentices learn Chinese, crane, pole, and drunken fighting to defeat an arrogant bully.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: Action king, David Chiang plays Wei Feng, who is sent to investigate the suspicious Tien family. However, he never expects to fall for the beautiful Chi.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: This tragic tale depicts the life of Fang Pi Yu, a singer whose husband dies in his attempt to free her from her past, and whose father-in-law throws her out.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: Trouble ensues after Ah To (Gordon Liu) marries a Japanese martial artist (Yuka Mizuno) and has a need to prove his martial prowess.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A trio of heroes go up against a power-hungry Ming Dynasty official and also cross paths with three beauties.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Hsuan sets out to apprehend George Eaton, a high profile thug who has escaped to Hong Kong. With home support, can Yang take him down?

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: Written and directed by Cheng Kang, this classic film starring Yueh Wah depicts how the Sung Dynasty army's chief instructor is framed by a corrupt minister.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: If you liked House of 72 Tenants, you won't want to miss out on this humorous, fun-filled sequel complete with 10 more tenants!

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: Directed by Lee Han-hsiang and starring Michael Hui, this blockbuster confirms Hui's versatile talents as the king of comedy.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: 60s pop star Carrie Ku Mei plays pop star 'Little Lark' in her greatest role, in this romance that features some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Hidden Power of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: When defeated villain, Sung Ching-shu, restarts his reign of terror after mastering the yin and yang combination, only two swordsmen can stop him.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this comedic sequel to the 36th Chamber of Shaolin, Gordon Liu is hired to impersonate the 36th Chamber's founder!

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: In Part 2 of this adventure, only the title weapons' union can save the 6 remaining sects which vie for mastery of the martial world.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: Cheng Tien Chi plays a righteous priest with supernatural powers, who returns from the dead to wreak havoc against one of the corrupt kingdoms.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: Winner of Best Picture in the 12th Asian Film Festival, this Huangmei Opera epic stars Li Li Hua and Ivy Ling Po in a romance that stretches across the decades.

programme.title: The Master of Kung Fu
programme.desc: In this action-packed experimental piece, an all-too-human Huang Fei-hung battles a gangster's plan to frame him for robbery and murder.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: Chiao Hsiung plays a bandit who steals from the rich and gives to the poor, all the while risking the threat of his evil nemesis, the evil bounty hunter Wang.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll by
programme.desc: A doctor falls for a schizophrenic old classmate he's treating who refuses to accept that her lover is dead.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: 17-year-old Wong Fei Hung is prompted to go and do battle to avenge a friend's death and protect his family honour.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: The Sword and the Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner go on a mission to destroy the Phoenix Lute, a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and can only be destroyed by the Kan sword.

programme.title: Torrent of Desire
programme.desc: Flames of lust burn strongly in this high-octane melodrama that stars Jenny Hu, Yang Fan and Qiao Zhuang.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: The peaceful life of Golden Swallow is shattered when her unrequited suitor, Silver Roc, begins a killing spree to draw her out of seclusion. Stars Cheng Pei Pei, Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: In this saga of warring clans, revenge and the ultimate martial arts skills, Yun, a young swordsman, battles the odds to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Kid With a Tattoo
programme.desc: Starring kung-fu comedienne Wang Yu on a mission of justice, this film is kicked into high gear by Yuen Hua, Yuan Pin and the villainous Wang Lung-wei.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Lady of the Law

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty

programme.title: Men From the Gutter

programme.desc: SANTAI MALAM BERSAMA PENYAMPAI AJ, REDZA DAN AIZAT DENGAN LAGU-LAGU HITS DAN POPULAR. SEGMEN PILIHAN BERSAMA MENANTI PENDENGAR MENERUSI FB DAN TIK TOK LIVE NASIONALfm. SLOT KAUNTER ARTIS BERSAMA ARTIS DAN SELEBRITI POPULAR SETIAP HARI RABU 9.15 MALAM - 10 MALAM.\n

programme.title: NASIONAL GBH
programme.desc: SANTAI MALAM BERSAMA GENG BURUNG HANTU ABANG MANIS NAZA, AIZAT, REDZA DAN KAKAK MANIS AIDA GIA DENGAN PENGISIAN LAGU-LAGU HITS MELAYU DAN RETRO SERTA PERKONGSIAN TOPIK SEMASA DAN MENARIK MENERUSI LIVE DI TIK TOK. ISTIMEWA SEGMEN MISTERI MALAM DI SEBALIK MATA (1 PAGI - 2 PAGI) BERKOLABORASI BERSAMA PENYAMPAI SALAMfm SETIAP AHAD PAGI. JUGA DENGARKAN RANCANGAN RAUDHAH PUKUL 5.15 PAGI.

programme.title: NASIONAL PAGI
programme.desc: Bersama 3 Suara iaitu Sonic, Dyya dan Nazri yang menceriakan suasana pagi anda dengan informasi terkini. Diselitkan juga segman unik dan menarik seperti Tahukah Anda, Tular dan Global dengan pengisian lagu-lagu terkini dan popular.Turut diselitan lagu-lagu hits yang popular dari tahun 70-an hingga 2019 dan slot muzik bermaklumat tanpa henti. Pelbagai perkongsian berita dan info terkini.

programme.title: NASIONAL ASPIRASI.
programme.desc: LAGU-LAGU MALAR SEGAR YANG HITS DAN POPULAR MENGGAMIT KENANGAN BERSAMA PENYAMPAI AZEL & IZZ AZLAN. DENGAN PENGISIAN PROGRAM BUAL BICARA ALFA DAN SLOT TAJAAN.

programme.title: NASIONAL RELAKS
programme.desc: LAGU-LAGU POPULAR DAN HITS DENGAN INFO MENARIK BERSAMA PENYAMPAI EZZY MARZAUKI, AIDA GIA DAN AIZAT. SLOT 2.30 PETANG: JALAN TERUS SAMPAI JADI (SELASA), EKSKLUSIF (ISNIN-JUMAAT).DENGARKAN SLOT SUARA 34 PUNCAK PRESTASI (SABTU-AHAD) PADA 3.20 PETANG-3.54 PETANG, MANAKALA PROGRAM SILANG BUDAYA (SABTU-AHAD) PADA 3 PETANG - 4 PETANG, MENERUSI FB DAN TIK TOK LIVE NASIONALfm.

programme.title: NASIONAL WARNA GKP
programme.desc: SANTAI PETANG DENGAN PENYAMPAI GENG KAKAK PETANG ZURA DAN LYNN (ISNIN-JUMAAT) . PENGISIAN LAGU-LAGU POPULAR RETRO DENGAN SEGMEN LUAHAN KAKAK ABANG, RESEPI MANJA-MANJA JE DAN DRAMA DALAM KERETA (RABU & KHAMIS). SEGMAN BIS ON AIR JUGA AKAN BERSIARAN PADA 6.00 PETANG SERTA INFO DAN TOPIK SEMASA YANG MENARIK SEMASA PEMANDUAN. JUGA BERSIARAN MENERUSI LIVE TIK TOK NASIONALfm. programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.desc: Wan Ibrahim perlu mencari penyelesaian segera untuk melarikan diri daripada pakciknya, Wan Usin, dengan menjual beberapa jongkong emas yang dirompak oleh mereka, dan dia perlu melalui pelbagai cabaran.

programme.title: Resipi
programme.desc: Radiah pindah semula ke rumah ibubapanya demi untuk menjaga ayahnya lalu mula memasak mengikut resipi arwah ibunya, dalam usahanya Radiah mula mempelajari tentang dirinya dan juga tentang ibu dan ayahnya.

programme.title: Strawberi Karipap Hello Gold Coast
programme.desc: Nini dan Haikal pergi bercuti ke Gold Coast, Australia. Percutian mereka tidak berjalan seperti yang dirancang. Namun akhirnya ia menjadi satu pengembaraan yang hebat.

programme.title: Jejaka Terhangat Di Pasaran
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a handsome man, Azrul, who is a favorite of many women at his workplace. They do various things to win Azrul's heart.

programme.title: Luar Biasa
programme.desc: Kisah yang diinspirasikan daripada pemenang pingat emas Paralimpik, Mohamad Ridzuan yang menghadapi penyakit 'Cebral Palsy' dan abangnya yang sentiasa ada di sisinya.

programme.title: Sekolah Api
programme.desc: Api, gangster yang meningkat naik cuba memenuhi amanat arwah neneknya untuk menghabiskan SPM. Dia jatuh cinta dengan guru Bahasa Inggeris dan sanggup melakukan apa saja untuk memenangi hati guru tersebut.

programme.title: Balapan
programme.desc: Kisah empat orang remaja yang telah menjadi musuh sejak sekian lama di lapangan balapan acara pecut 100meter peringkat daerah Selangor dan akhirnya menjadi sahabat seperjuangan.

programme.title: Lampu Merah
programme.desc: Si lelaki sukakan si perempuan, tanpa sedar yang si perempuan itu psiko dan obses dengan cintanya. Cara untuk selamatkan diri hanya dengan jatuh cinta dengan si perempuan semula.

programme.title: Bini Aku Dari...
programme.desc: Lydia dan Rudy telah pun berkahwin. Lydia nak anak walaupun Rudy belum bersedia lagi. Perangai Lydia makin menjadi- jadi apabila mengikut hukum hakam dari kakiberamal.com.

programme.title: Tebus
programme.desc: Anak perempuan Mikail telah di culik dan untuk menyelamatkan anaknya dia cuba mengimbau kembali sejarah lampau dirinya ketika menyertai kumpulan gangster.

programme.title: Survival 486
programme.desc: Syuhada going hiking to Gunung Tahan with her friends. Unfortunately, she got lost and fell into a deep hole and trapped there for 19 days.

programme.title: Budak Dari Tak Bai
programme.desc: Melalui kehidupan yang getir, Johari meninggalkan Tak Bai pada zaman kanak-kanak ke Kota Bharu. Peristiwa hitam membuatkannya hanyut dalam dunia gelap. Dilakonkan oleh Kamal Adli dan Nabila Huda.

programme.title: Delen
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Delen yang mula rasa terancam apabila Emily mula menyukai pelajar baru bernama Robert. Sejak itu, bermulalah persaingan antara Delen dan Robert demi merebut cinta Emily.

programme.title: Bro Jenin
programme.desc: Kisah Jenin yang telah masuk ke zaman kini. Dia berjumpa dengan seorang animator, Emily. Wujud perbezaan pendapat maka terjadi lah kisah2 lucu dan akhirnya Jenin terpaksa pulang ke tempat asalnya.

programme.title: Bibik Aku Nak Kahwin
programme.desc: Milah yang terlalu berharap untuk berkahwin, akhirnya menemui jodoh secara tiba-tiba. Lakonan Didie Alias, Hairul Azreen dan Nabila AF.

programme.title: Baby-Sita
programme.desc: Two grand-theft-auto and best friends Adam & Hatim discovered a baby at the back seat of a stolen car. Keen to avoid detection, they take care of the baby while figuring out how to return the baby without getting caught

programme.title: Baby Jarum
programme.desc: Mami Jarum is back! and this time Mami is making sure her grand-daughter Asyikin will marry the man of her choosing, however Asyikin has a better plan (or worse!) for herself.

programme.title: Challenge Accepted
programme.desc: Jeff seorang tiktokers terkenal. Jeff telah berjaya membuat seoarang gadis,Fatimah jatuh cinta padanya tetapi akhirnya Fatimah mendapat tahu yang Jeff hanya menggunakannya demi populariti.

programme.title: Diari Chinta
programme.desc: Chinta selalu gagal dalam cintanya diberikan sebuah diari ajaib untuk menulis babak cinta. Impian yang ditulis Chinta itu menjadi kenyataan dengan kemunculan Ben namun tidaklah selancar yang disangka.

programme.title: Kipas Belum Mati
programme.desc: Mia, seorang artis meningkat naik, membuka kelab peminatnya dan dibantu oleh Lynn yang menjadi pengurus. Dengan bantuan Lynn, kelabnya maju namun ada harga yang harus dibayar di sebalik kejayaan tersebut..

programme.title: Fried Chicken Night
programme.desc: Nothing says comfort food better than fried chicken. Chef Spencer Watts shows us all the fixings for a fast, easy, and delicious fried chicken night.

programme.title: Three course Argentinian meal
programme.desc: Award-winning chef Natalia Machado from Argentina makes palm heart and shrimp salad, beef stew in a pumpkin, roasted pork spare ribs with a delicious marinade, and addictive dulce de leche ice cream.

programme.title: Comfort Food
programme.desc: Baking host Jessica McGovern warms up the kitchen with some melty, creamy, and chewy treats to comfort you on a rainy day.

programme.title: Urban Eats
programme.desc: Fa-what? Fa-waffles! Desiree Nielsen cooks up protein-rich falafel waffles for breakfast.

programme.title: Croatia + Barbados
programme.desc: CombiNATION time! Barbados is the sun-drenched island of enchantment where Chef Craig starts this culinary adventure. Check out Bajan Spice Snapper with Curried Pumpkin for a Caribbean taste sensation! Next comes a feast for the eyes with Oxtail PasÌŒticada from Croatia, served with a truffle sauce that melts in your mouth, and also in your heart! Turns out that both of these countries love... shrimp! Check out the Croatian creation with tomatoes and plum brandy; for Barbados? It's grilled with spice and dipped in mango-chili sauce. The Big Dish is Monkfish wrapped in PrsÌŒut, a smoky Croatian dry-cured ham, served with scotch bonnet-spiked tomatoes and Barbadian Cou cou made with corn and okra.

programme.title: Madagascar + Belgium
programme.desc: First up, Belgium is famous for its mussels and fries, aka 'Moule Frite'. Chef Wong has a unique take featuring Belgian beer steamed mussels salad, waffle cut fries, and potato-leek mousse. Next, Steak Madagascar is an old school fine-dining fave, this take, uses modernist 'spherification' for the sauce, and a vanilla bean rub for a steak that is decidedly not 'old school', wow! For a common ingredient, how about sweet breakfast? Belgians are famous for Liege Waffles, and Madagascar loves Mofogasy, a pancake made with rice flour and coconut. The final dish is inspired by Belgian Waterzooi, a root veggie stew, mixed with a popular Malagesy stir-fry with shellfish and pork... Chef carefully and skillfully balances all the elements, using lobster, bacon breadcrumbs, and adding a modern touch with mango pickle 'pearls'!

programme.title: Peru + Lebanon
programme.desc: Tiraditos! No, it's not a joyous exclamation (even though it sounds a little like one...) it's a Peruvian dish that lands somewhere between traditional Peruvian ceviche and Japanese sashimi. Chef Craig Wong's version is made with swordfish and includes sweet potatoes pureed with spicy Aji Amarillo chilies. For his Lebanese tribute, check out Lamb Neck cured and slow-poached in olive oil for a melt-in- your-mouth result, paired with an intense, flavourful Black Baba Ghanoush made with charred eggplant and caramelized onions. For a common ingredient, it is two takes on potato: Lomo Saltado with grilled flank steak, and a cheese, herb, olive oil and lemon drenched Hasselback Batata Harra. Squab is on the final plate blending Lebanese flavours like sumac, pomegranate, and pistachio with Peruvian ones like sweet corn, squash, and lime. What a CombiNation!

programme.title: South Africa + Portugal
programme.desc: This CombiNation Plates culinary adventure starts in Portugal with a Scallop dish that features some of their finest ingredients, such as Port Wine, ChouricÌ§o sausage, Kale, and Figs. Next up is South Africa and the feature is an Ostrich Steak, served with native Cape Gooseberries, the bizarrely named "Monkey Gland Sauce" (don't worry, no monkeys and very few glands are involved). The common ingredient is Peri Peri peppers, featured first on a Grilled Sardine with Olive Soil for a peak Portugal experience, then on the Peri Peri Chicken dish that South Africa made internationally famous. The combination plate is always the big finale... Stand back in awe for Chef Craig's Giant Braaied (aka 'grilled') Veal Chop with Clams 'Alentejana', served with a sweet-tart tropical Fruit Salad to balance the plate.

programme.title: Kohlrabi, Fennel, Kale and Red Cabbage
programme.desc: Host Amanda Herrera shows us why fresh is always best with two creative dishes using ingredients from the farmers' market.

programme.title: Raspberries, Mint, Peas and Apricot

programme.title: Campania

programme.title: Minty Mango Lamb & Mexi-Poblanos
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are bringing bold flavours and creative BBQ twists to the barn with a menu packed with colour and spice. They toss a grilled corn salad, stuff smoky poblano peppers with Oaxaca cheese, fire up lamb steaks with mango mint chutney, and bake orange peel cinnamon buns.

programme.title: Seafood Cookout & Creamy Taters
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki bring a taste of the coast to the barn with a BBQ feast full of fresh seafood and comforting sides. They grill oysters topped with serrano ham, fill avocados with crab, fire up lobster tails with basil mayo, and serve green bean salad with creamy BBQ scalloped potatoes.

programme.title: Trentino-Alto Adige
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Sardegna
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Friuli Venezia Guilia
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Sardegna
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Friuli Venezia Guilia
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Spaghetti
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Moules Frites
programme.desc: Crack open a mussel or two, this episode of Up the Dish begins in Belgium, but please, no waffles! Host Micah Trainor makes Moules- Frites, mussels steamed in white wine and shows her trick for bistro- style French fries. Next, Tiera Singh steals the show with her Mussel Broth Vichyssoise and Smoked Mussels, an ultra-creamy cold soup that's paired with smoky shellfish for fantastic flavour. Vegetarian mussels? Missy Hui says "no worries!" and makes Saffron Artichokes with zesty Lemon Chili Oil - there's a little bit of everything in each delectable bite! How does Poppy Sandler send the episode off? By turning it on its head! Fried mussels with Celeriac Remoulade salad makes for a satisfying ending to Up the Dish.

programme.title: Dumplings
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

programme.title: Lasagna
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

programme.title: Vinegar
programme.desc: Chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts shows how vinegar, a simple pantry staple, can bring out the flavours of walleye, lobster and crawfish.

programme.title: Cocktails
programme.desc: Seafood lover and chef Spencer Watts brings the party to the kitchen and shows that cocktails aren't just for drinking, they're also an inspiration for cooking great seafood.

programme.title: Cold
programme.desc: Cooking doesn't always have to bring the heat. Chef and fish lover Spencer Watts shows you how to prepare cold dishes with arctic char and shrimp.

programme.title: Wrapped
programme.desc: Chef Spencer Watts has fun wrapping some of his favourite seafood to create delicious dishes with swordfish and shrimp.

programme.title: Cassoulet
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Carrot Cake
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Borscht
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Seafood Boil
programme.desc: Micah Trainor boils it down for this episode of Up the Dish! Her Cajun Seafood Boil simmers with luscious lobster, smoky andouille, and supERS-sized crab; a perfect blend of zesty, spicy, and succulent. It's a hard act to follow, but Missy Hui is up for it. Her Corned Beef Boiled Dinner is a call back to the Emerald Isle - home-cured pickled beef bubbles away with veggies in a beefy broth. Poppy Sandler's vegetarian addition? Moroccan Vegetable Stew! A North African-style spice blend heats this dish up, while chickpeas and other veggies soak up the flavour. Tiera Singh takes a spicy approach with her one-pot delight - Guyanese Pepperpot. Loaded with scotch-bonnet peppers, osso bucco, and demi-glace, this dish delivers a rich and impressive punch to the tastebuds.

programme.desc: Argentinian-born chef Natalia Machado makes grilled calamari salad, followed by grilled pizza, and then shows us how to make lamb ravioli, before finishing it off with the best-ever cookies: alfajores.

programme.title: Mexico + Norway
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: Summer Fun

The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: Fire & Spice
programme.desc: Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies and a blend of fresh hot peppers.

programme.title: Spanish Flare
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: The Butter Did It
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.desc: It's all about the letter "S" as Chef Robert Jewell cooks up tasty meals using shrimp and sausage. For his first recipe, Robert fries up turmeric-spiced sweet potato fritters with a shrimp centre. He takes this tantalizing appetizer to another level with a savoury lime soy dipping sauce. Next up, Robert makes an English breakfast strata. This sausage casserole is easily the BEST way to start your day. He layers the bottom of the dish with buttered sourdough slices, before adding crispy fried sausages, leeks and tomatoes. He then covers it in a creamy egg mixture, crumbles stilton on top and bakes it to golden brown. Finally, Robert combines shrimp and sausage into one flavourful dish.

programme.title: Salmon Salad Niçoise
programme.desc: How many ways can salmon be prepared? Up the Dish is on a mission to find out! Tiera Singh's Salmon Salad NiÃ§oise is a staple of the French Riviera with shallot, eggs, and haricot verts, but she swaps out the tuna for luxuriant olive oil poached salmon - it may not be traditional but it sure tastes good! Poppy Sandler smokes the competition with a buttery Smoked Salmon Omelette, garnished with fresh chives and earthy goat cheese. Next, Micah Trainor skips the salmon but keeps the veggies for her steamed Tofu Nori Dim Sum Dumplings, with tart gingERS-pickled shallots and tons of green goodness. Missy Hui has the big finish; her Salmon with Béarnaise is cooked sous vide for a precisely cooked fish dish and served alongside Pommes Anna for a plate that's straight out of Paris.

programme.title: Ireland + Japan
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe; for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: Dumplings
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!
